process: LanzaTech BOF-gas fermentation to ethanol, US model plant co-located with a steel mill (Table 1)
value: Basic oxygen furnace gas (50-60% CO) is deoxygenated and compressed, fermented by microbes using CO as carbon and energy source in a continuous bioreactor, and the broth distilled and dehydrated to ethanol; solids and liquid wastes go to on-site anaerobic digestion whose biogas, mixed with vent gas, raises steam; electricity from the grid.

process: LanzaTech BOF-gas fermentation to ethanol, US model plant co-located with a steel mill (Table 1)
value: Demonstrated at a 300 t/yr plant with Baosteel (Shanghai) and a second demonstration plant with Shougang (Caofeidian); both exceeded nameplate capacity. Inventory from LanzaTech commercial plant design.

process: LanzaTech BOF-gas fermentation to ethanol, US model plant co-located with a steel mill (Table 1)

process: LanzaTech biomass gasification and fermentation to ethanol, corn stover (Table 1)
value: Corn stover is gasified to syngas (30-35% CO, 40-45% H2), the hot syngas cooled to raise steam and power in CHP, and the syngas fermented to ethanol and distilled; all utilities generated internally with surplus power exported.
